name: Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Weiming Environment Protection Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, invests, manufactures, constructs, and operates environment protection equipment in China and internationally. It operates through five segments: Solid Waste Treatment, Kitchen Waste and Sewage Treatment, Hazardous Waste Treatment, Smart Sanitation, and Engineering Equipment.
